description: Admin tool. Change an existing application with PUT /application/{name}. Fields you omit stay unchanged; regions and ports, when given, replace the whole list. Warning: the server ignores tls on ports sent through edit and stores tls=false, so sending ports here turns off TLS on every port. Omit ports to keep existing TLS ports; set TLS ports with gameye_create_application. Needs the application:write scope. Pass dryRun=true to preview the request.

dryRun.description: Return the exact request that would be sent, with the API token masked, and send nothing

cpu.description: CPU cores the container may use (hard limit)

gpu.description: GPUs the container may use (hard limit)

ram.description: RAM in MB the container may use (hard limit)

name.description: Name of the application to edit

ports.description: Container ports; replaces the whole list and stores tls=false on every port, whatever you send

tls.description: Gameye terminates TLS for this port on the host; the game server still speaks plain TCP in the container. Only gameye_create_application applies it; ports sent through gameye_edit_application end up tls=false

regions.description: Region names; replaces the whole list

registry.description: Name of a Gameye image registry, e.g. 'dockerhub' or 'ghcr'. The server looks the name up and returns 404 if it is unknown; gameye_list_applications shows the names your applications use

repository.description: Image repository in that registry, without a tag

cpu.description: CPU cores reserved on the node when scheduling

gpu.description: GPUs reserved on the node when scheduling

ram.description: RAM in MB reserved on the node when scheduling

tagKeep.description: How many image tags Gameye keeps for this application

name: gameye_edit_application
title: Edit application
